result.stdout:
Usage: runic-translations generate [options]

Generate translation artifacts.

With no --emit-* option, renders C#, locale-v5 JSON with its asset manifest, and
ESM. With any, renders only the selected groups.

Exit codes: 0 success; 1 translation or verification diagnostics; 2 invalid
invocation or operational failure.

Options:
  --project <directory>        Translations directory or its runic.json.
                               Defaults to ./runic.json, then
                               ./translations/runic.json.
  --output <directory>         Directory to write the artifacts to. [required]
  --emit-csharp                Render the typed C# API.
  --emit-json                  Render locale-v5 JSON and its asset manifest.
  --emit-esm                   Render the ESM package and
                               web-module-manifest-v3.json.
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --runic-output <human|json>  Select output format

Examples:
  runic-translations generate --output obj/translations --emit-esm

result.stdout:
Usage: runic-translations init [options]

Create an RMF2 translation project and starter resources.

Writes runic.json and one .rmf2 file per locale into a new or empty directory.

Options:
  --directory <directory>      Directory to create the project in. [required]
  --catalog <catalog>          Portable catalog identifier. [required]
  --default-locale <locale>    Base locale tag, such as en. [required]
  --namespace <namespace>      Namespace of the generated C# API. [required]
  --class <name>               Class name of the generated C# API. [required]
  --locale <locale...>         Additional locale as <tag> or <tag>:<fallback>;
                               repeatable.
  --no-starter                 Create the files without the starter message.
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --runic-output <human|json>  Select output format

Examples:
  runic-translations init --directory translations --catalog app --default-locale en --locale de --namespace MyApp --class AppText

result.stdout:
Usage: runic-translations verify [options]

Check that generated artifacts match the sources.

Renders in memory and compares byte for byte with --output, including extra
files. With no --emit-* option, renders C#, locale-v5 JSON with its asset
manifest, and ESM. With any, renders only the selected groups.

Exit codes: 0 success; 1 translation or verification diagnostics; 2 invalid
invocation or operational failure.

Options:
  --project <directory>        Translations directory or its runic.json.
                               Defaults to ./runic.json, then
                               ./translations/runic.json.
  --output <directory>         Directory with the artifacts to compare.
                               [required]
  --emit-csharp                Compare the typed C# API.
  --emit-json                  Compare locale-v5 JSON and its asset manifest.
  --emit-esm                   Compare the ESM package and
                               web-module-manifest-v3.json.
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --runic-output <human|json>  Select output format

Examples:
  runic-translations verify --output obj/translations --emit-esm
